summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting an amendment (dated October 12, 2026) to the certificate of designation governing its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA). The amendment sets a binding minimum sale price of $100.00 per share for future SATA sales, formalizing a prior policy, and redefines Business Day to allow Saturday/Sunday dividend accrual if market utilities permit. No board recommendation, advisor, price-per-share deal, stake, or ownership change is stated. This is a routine charter amendment modifying security-holder rights, not a special situation. Watch for any future capital raises below stated policy and broader preferred governance shifts.
